query: Which month-by-month milestones and contingency triggers (IRB delays, archival access, OCR failure) should populate Years 1–2 Gantt schedule?

response.query: Which month-by-month milestones and contingency triggers (IRB delays, archival access, OCR failure) should populate Years 1–2 Gantt schedule?
response.answer: Year 1: Month-by-month milestones include project initiation, IRB approval, and initial data collection. Year 2: Key milestones include data analysis and final report completion. Contingency triggers include IRB delays and OCR failures.
